item.title: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls and requires returnees from Congo to pay for quarantine
item.description: Uganda is reinforcing existing border controls requiring citizens returning from Congo to undergo 21 days of quarantine at their own expense, the Health Ministry said Sunday, as investigators examine how a woman who traveled from Uganda to Nigeria contracted Ebola.

item.title: Police in Florida are seeking information and videos after a shooting injured 12 at football game
item.description: Florida police are asking for tips, photos, and videos as they investigate a weekend shooting that injured 12 people, including six minors, outside a college football celebration.

item.title: More flooding possible in Four Corners region after days of heavy rain
item.description: A rain-soaked swath of the Southwest U.S. is bracing for another round of potentially heavy showers and thunderstorms after days of rain forced evacuations and water rescues.
